parse_longcat_tool_calls: parse raw model output text containing <longcat_tool_call> tags and extract structured tool calls
register_longcat_parser: register the LongcatToolCallParser class under the 'longcat' name in the parser registry
get_longcat_parser: get a LongcatToolCallParser instance by name from the tool call parser registry
list_registered_parsers: list all registered tool call parser names including the longcat parser
parse_longcat_content: extract text content and tool calls from Longcat Flash Chat model output text
